title: Scientists can’t stop using AI, even when forbidden from doing so | New Scientist
description: When scientists were asked to review papers for a conference without using AI tools, many of them ignored the request and used AI anyway
author: Chris Stokel-Walker

title: Our food system is vulnerable to El Niño, warns UK climate minister | New Scientist
description: Extreme weather could damage harvests worldwide, but the answer is more local food production, not stockpiling, Katie White said in an interview with New Scientist
author: Alec Luhn

title: AI finds 3D shape that fills all space with a never-repeating pattern | New Scientist
description: A 3D shape that can tile 3D space, leaving no gaps and never forming a repeating pattern, has been discovered using an AI model. The researcher behind the findings, who has no academic background in the area, says his work has angered professional mathematicians
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Why is this monster El Niño so strong? | New Scientist
description: Though the El Niño is still months from its peak, it is already breaking many records. Two main factors are behind how it became so powerful
author: Michael Le Page

title: Blood test could gauge if a baby has a dangerous infection in 15 minutes | New Scientist
description: Feverish babies in hospital are often assumed to have a serious bacterial infection and are treated with antibiotics. But a test that gauges whether the infection is bacterial or viral, which tend to be milder, could prevent unnecessary drug use
author: Michael Marshall

title: Virtual green spaces and classical music reduce blood pressure in hospital | New Scientist
description: Watching a river flow via a virtual-reality headset while listening to classical music seems to quickly bring people's blood pressure down from a dangerously high level in hospital
author: Chris Simms
